ZFSMgr
Cross-platform ZFS manager.
Author: Eladio Linares
License: GNU
translations.t_clone_dst_req001: The target dataset cannot be empty.
translations.t_clone_need_sel001:
To clone you must select:
- In Source: a snapshot
- In Target: a dataset (not a snapshot)
translations.t_clone_props_ph1:
One property per line, for example:
compression=lz4
atime=off
translations.t_clone_same_conn1: Clone requires Source and Target to be on the same connection.
translations.t_clone_same_pool1: Clone requires Source and Target to be in the same pool.
translations.t_complete_a_77b969: Fill at least Host and User to test the connection.
translations.t_copiar_mod_b1d73e: Copy: remote-local mode (source and target on same connection)
translations.t_desglosar__c61afc: Break down canceled or no selection.
translations.t_diff_need_sel001:
To diff you must select:
- In Source: a snapshot
- In Target: its parent dataset or a snapshot of the same dataset
translations.t_diff_other_snap001: Diffing a snapshot against itself yields no changes. Select the parent dataset or another snapshot.
translations.t_diff_same_conn001: Diff requires Source and Target to be on the same connection.
translations.t_diff_same_parent001: Diff requires Target to be the parent dataset of the source snapshot, or another snapshot of the same dataset.
translations.t_diff_same_pool001: Diff requires Source and Target to be in the same pool.
